18: shortTitle: Troubleshooting access
19: category:
20:   - Apply for GitHub Education
21: ---
22: 
23: ## Why wasn't my application approved?
24: 
25: If your application was denied, review these list of common reasons.
26: 
27: ### Unclear academic affiliation documents
28: 
29: If the dates or schedule mentioned in your uploaded image do not match our eligibility criteria, we require further proof of your academic status.
30: 
31: If the image you uploaded doesn't clearly identify your current academic status or if the uploaded image is blurry, we require further proof of your academic status. {% data reusables.education.upload-proof-reapply %}
32: 
33: ### Using an academic email with an unverified domain
34: 
35: If your academic email address has an unverified domain, we require further proof of your academic status. {% data reusables.education.upload-proof-reapply %}
36: 
37: ### Using an academic email from a school with lax email policies
38: 
39: If your school issues email addresses prior to paid student enrollment, we require further proof of your academic status. {% data reusables.education.upload-proof-reapply %}
40: 
41: If you have other questions or concerns about the school domain please ask your school IT staff to contact us.
42: 
43: ### Academic email address already used
44: 
45: If your academic email address was already used to request a {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %} for a different {% data variables.product.prodname_dotcom %} account, you cannot reuse the academic email address to successfully apply for another {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %}.
46: 
47: > [!NOTE]
48: > It is against the {% data variables.product.prodname_dotcom %} [Terms of Service](/site-policy/github-terms/github-terms-of-service#3-account-requirements) to maintain more than one individual account.
49: 
50: If you have more than one personal account, you must merge your accounts. To retain the discount, keep the account that was granted the discount. You can rename the retained account and keep your contribution history by adding all your email addresses to the retained account.
51: 
52: For more information, see:
53: * [AUTOTITLE](/account-and-profile/how-tos/account-management/merging-multiple-personal-accounts)
54: * [AUTOTITLE](/account-and-profile/concepts/username-changes)
55: * [AUTOTITLE](/account-and-profile/how-tos/email-preferences/adding-an-email-address-to-your-github-account)
56: 
57: ### Why does the application require an academic email?
58: 
59: {% data variables.product.github %}'s verification process is individually tailored. When the system detects that recent applicants from your school successfully verified using their academic email, future applicants from the same school must also use an academic email.
60: 
61: **What to do:**
62: 
63: * **Get your academic email:** Contact your school's IT or administrative office. This is the fastest path to verification.
64: * **School doesn't issue academic emails?** Provide official documentation (such as a school webpage or a letter on school letterhead) explaining the policy.
65: * **School domain not recognized?** [Contact GitHub Education Support](https://support.github.com/contact/education) and include your school's full name, website URL, and the domain you are attempting to use.
66: * **Email formatting issues:** Ensure your email address is all lowercase and doesn't use plus-addressing (such as "user+school@example.com"). If needed, delete and re-add it under **Settings > Emails**.
67: * **Tried everything and still stuck?** [Contact {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} Support](https://support.github.com/contact/education) and include which steps you attempted, what happened at each step, and where you encountered an issue.
68: 
69: ### Ineligible student status
70: 
71: You're ineligible for a {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %} if:
72: * You're enrolled in an informal learning program that is not part of the [{% data variables.product.prodname_campus_program %}](https://education.github.com/schools) and not enrolled in a degree or diploma granting course of study.
73: * You're pursuing a degree which will be terminated in the current academic session.
74: * You're under 13 years old.
75: 
76: Your instructor may still apply for a {% data variables.product.prodname_education %} discount for classroom use. If you're a student at a coding school or bootcamp, you will become eligible for a {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %} if your school joins the [{% data variables.product.prodname_campus_program %}](https://education.github.com/schools).
77: 
78: ## Can I transfer discounts from one account to another?
79: 
80: No. If you have more than one account you want to apply the discount to, [merge](/account-and-profile/how-tos/account-management/merging-multiple-personal-accounts) your personal accounts and [rename](/account-and-profile/concepts/username-changes) the retained account if desired.
81: 
82: ## How do I renew my access?
83: 
84: Once your {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} access expires, you may reapply if you're still eligible, although some of our partner offers for {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %} cannot renew. Most of the timed offers from our partners start once you set them up.
85: 
86: To reapply, first make sure that you are signed in to your {% data variables.product.github %} account.
87: 
88: {% data reusables.education.apply-to-github-eduction-procedures %}

59: {% data variables.product.github %}'s verification process is individually tailored. When the system detects that recent applicants from your school successfully verified using their academic email, future applicants from the same school must also use an academic email.
60: 
61: **What to do:**
62: 
63: * **Get your academic email:** Contact your school's IT or administrative office. This is the fastest path to verification.
64: * **School doesn't issue academic emails?** Provide official documentation (such as a school webpage or a letter on school letterhead) explaining the policy.
65: * **School domain not recognized?** [Contact GitHub Education Support](https://support.github.com/contact/education) and include your school's full name, website URL, and the domain you are attempting to use.
66: * **Email formatting issues:** Ensure your email address is all lowercase and doesn't use plus-addressing (such as "user+school@example.com"). If needed, delete and re-add it under **Settings > Emails**.
67: * **Tried everything and still stuck?** [Contact {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} Support](https://support.github.com/contact/education) and include which steps you attempted, what happened at each step, and where you encountered an issue.
68: 
69: ### Ineligible student status
70: 
71: You're ineligible for a {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %} if:
72: * You're enrolled in an informal learning program that is not part of the [{% data variables.product.prodname_campus_program %}](https://education.github.com/schools) and not enrolled in a degree or diploma granting course of study.
73: * You're pursuing a degree which will be terminated in the current academic session.
74: * You're under 13 years old.
75: 
76: Your instructor may still apply for a {% data variables.product.prodname_education %} discount for classroom use. If you're a student at a coding school or bootcamp, you will become eligible for a {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %} if your school joins the [{% data variables.product.prodname_campus_program %}](https://education.github.com/schools).
77: 
78: ## Can I transfer discounts from one account to another?
79: 
80: No. If you have more than one account you want to apply the discount to, [merge](/account-and-profile/how-tos/account-management/merging-multiple-personal-accounts) your personal accounts and [rename](/account-and-profile/concepts/username-changes) the retained account if desired.
81: 
82: ## How do I renew my access?
83: 
84: Once your {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} access expires, you may reapply if you're still eligible, although some of our partner offers for {% data variables.product.prodname_student_pack %} cannot renew. Most of the timed offers from our partners start once you set them up.
85: 
86: To reapply, first make sure that you are signed in to your {% data variables.product.github %} account.
87:

20: 
21: You qualify for {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} if you:
22: 
23: * Are enrolled in a degree- or diploma-granting program, such as a high school, college, university, or homeschool.
24: * Provide documents that prove your current student status. See [Academic email requirements](#academic-email-requirements) below.
25: * Own a [{% data variables.product.prodname_dotcom %} personal account](/account-and-profile/how-tos/account-management/creating-an-account-on-github).
26: * Are at least 13 years old.
27: 
28: ## What documents can I use to prove I'm a student?
29: 
30: * A picture of your school ID with current enrollment date
31: * Your class schedule
32: * Your transcript
33: * An affiliation or enrollment verification letter
34:

36: 
37: {% data variables.product.github %}'s verification process is individually tailored. When the system detects that recent applicants from your school successfully verified using their academic email, future applicants from the same school must also use an academic email.

40:

42:

44: 
45: If your institution does not issue academic emails, provide official documentation, such as a school webpage or a letter on school letterhead, explaining the policy. Then reapply for {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %}.
46: 
47: ### Your school's email domain is not recognized
48: 
49: If your school email domain is not recognized in the application, [contact {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} Support](https://support.github.com/contact/education) with your school's full name, website URL, and the email domain you are attempting to use.
50: 
51: ## Applying to {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %}
52: 
53: {% data reusables.education.apply-to-github-eduction-procedures %}
54: 
55: Once your application is approved, navigate to your [{% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} portal](https://github.com/education) to use your {% data variables.product.prodname_global_campus %} benefits, such as **free access** to professional developer tools.
56: 
57: ## Further reading
58: 
59: * [AUTOTITLE](/education/about-github-education/github-education-for-students/solving-problems-with-your-github-education-access)
